mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.05 percentage points, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production and housing starts signals robust economic activity that boosts corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both rise from prior month
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both increase from the prior month, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeds 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST increases from the prior month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level exceeding 440,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 440,000 million dollars, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls and stable or declining federal funds rate signals a healthy labor market without monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rising and FEDFUNDS not rising
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and FEDFUNDS does not increase, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (quarterly real GDP growth rate exceeding 2.0%), corporate earnings are robust, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When quarterly real GDP growth exceeds 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
